name: coding-dev-lab
description: Run code anywhere. Multi-language execution, real-time compiler, and instant setup.

paragraphs: A Vietnamese-language algorithm practice platform where users solve programming problems, submit code, and receive automated evaluation results via Judge0.

GoCode is a full-stack algorithm practice platform for students. Users read problem statements, write code in a Monaco editor, submit solutions, and receive instant judging results from Judge0. The platform gamifies learning with streaks, heatmaps, and badges, and monetizes via a Premium/VIP subscription tier (Stripe).
Problem: Executing untrusted user code safely requires isolation, resource limits, and multi-language support.
features: Problem library across 8 topics (Arrays & Pointers, Strings, Linked Lists, Stack & Queue, Trees & Graphs, Dynamic Programming, Sorting & Searching, Hashing & Sets)
Code editor with Monaco Editor and syntax highlighting
Instant judging via Judge0 (CPU 2s, RAM 128MB limits)
Batch testing — submit up to 10 hidden tests at once with fail-fast polling

requirements.text: Login with unverified email returns a distinct 401 (not generic bad-credentials) and the sign-in screen offers a resend-verification button (10s cooldown)
Post-login redirect honors ?redirecturl= (internal paths only, open-redirect filtered)
